groups.zh: 软件智能体与仓库级开发

papers.en: SWE-Factory turns GitHub issues into training and evaluation tasks by building test environments and checking that each fix makes a failing test pass.
papers.zh: SWE-Factory 自动搭建测试环境，验证修复前失败的测试能否在修复后通过，把真实 GitHub issue 转化为软件智能体的训练和评测任务。

papers.en: OmniGIRL tests issue resolution across four programming languages, including cases where a screenshot helps explain what went wrong.
papers.zh: OmniGIRL 用四种编程语言的 GitHub issue 评测智能体的修复能力，覆盖需要结合截图理解的问题。

papers.en: Five agents use code context and analysis tools to identify service boundaries and split a monolithic application into microservices.
papers.zh: 五个智能体结合代码上下文和分析工具识别服务边界，将单体应用拆分为微服务。

papers.en: RLCoder learns which snippets to retrieve from other files by measuring how much they help a model predict the missing code.
papers.zh: RLCoder 用强化学习训练检索器，以代码片段对补全的实际帮助为反馈，学习从仓库的其他文件中选择上下文。

papers.en: RepoReasoner tests whether a model can trace execution across files by asking it to predict program outputs and function call chains.
papers.zh: RepoReasoner 让模型预测程序输出和函数调用链，检验它能否跨越多个文件追踪代码的执行过程。

papers.en: HumanEvo reconstructs the repository as it stood when a function was written to measure how later commits can inflate code-generation scores.
papers.zh: HumanEvo 还原开发者编写函数时的仓库版本，衡量后续提交中的信息会让代码生成得分虚高多少。

groups.en: Reliability and efficiency of generated code
groups.zh: 代码生成的可靠性与效率

papers.paper: LLM Hallucinations in Practical Code Generation:
papers.en: This study classifies the hallucinations that arise when models generate code within a repository and tests whether retrieving relevant context reduces them.
papers.zh: 研究归纳了大模型在仓库级代码生成中出现的幻觉类型，并检验检索相关上下文能否减少这些错误。

papers.en: A comparison of code written by developers and by language models reveals differences in readability, conciseness and robustness.
papers.zh: 通过对照开发者和大模型编写的代码，研究分析了两者在可读性、简洁性和健壮性上的差异。

papers.en: CodeFast uses a lightweight classifier to recognize when a code answer is complete and stop the model from generating unnecessary tokens.
papers.zh: CodeFast 用轻量分类器判断模型是否已写完所需代码，及时停止生成，省去输出多余 token 的推理开销。

papers.en: EffiReasonTrans trains a code translation model on verified examples, then uses reinforcement learning to reward translations that pass tests with fewer reasoning tokens.
papers.zh: EffiReasonTrans 先用经过验证的样例训练代码翻译模型，再用强化学习奖励通过测试且推理开销较低的翻译结果。

papers.en: UniXcoder learns from source code, comments and abstract syntax trees in a single model that supports both code understanding and generation.
papers.zh: UniXcoder 联合源代码、注释和抽象语法树进行预训练，让同一个模型支持代码理解与生成。

papers.en: CoCoSoDa masks or replaces tokens in code and queries, then uses contrastive learning to bring a query closer to its matching code.
papers.zh: CoCoSoDa 遮盖或替换代码和查询中的词元来构造训练样例，再用对比学习拉近自然语言查询与相关代码的表示。

papers.paper: Large Language Models Are Qualified Benchmark Builders:
papers.en: Replacing CodeSearchNet comments with model-written descriptions improved a retrained CodeT5 model on code summarization, generation and translation.
papers.zh: 用大模型重写 CodeSearchNet 中的代码注释后，重新预训练的 CodeT5 在代码摘要、生成和翻译任务上均有提升。

papers.paper: On the evaluation of neural code summarization
papers.en: Choices as small as the BLEU variant, preprocessing steps or dataset split can change the scores and rankings of code summarization models.
papers.zh: 即使评测同一批代码摘要模型，BLEU 的计算方式、代码预处理和数据集划分也会影响得分与排名。

groups.en: Memory and reasoning in foundation models
groups.zh: 基础模型的记忆与推理

papers.en: MemoryBank lets a language model recall earlier conversations and update its memories as time passes and topics recur.
papers.zh: MemoryBank 让语言模型在新对话中回忆以往的交流，并根据时间间隔和记忆的再次唤起更新记忆强度。

papers.en: AGIEval uses Chinese and English exams, including university entrance tests and math competitions, to probe foundation models’ knowledge and reasoning.
papers.zh: AGIEval 用中英文标准化考试题评测基础模型的知识与推理能力，题目涵盖高考、法律考试和数学竞赛。

papers.en: VGPO gives more training weight to reasoning steps and trajectories that stay grounded in the image.
papers.zh: VGPO 在训练中提高持续关注图像线索的推理步骤和轨迹的权重，缓解多模态模型在长推理中逐渐忽略图像的问题。
